description: This file defines functions related to validating OpenGL formats, types, and their combinations for desktop OpenGL in the ANGLE project. It includes functions to check if specific format and type enums are valid and if combinations of format, type, and internal format are compatible, following OpenGL 4.6 specifications.

methods.name: ValidDesktopFormat
methods.description: Checks if a given GLenum format is a valid desktop OpenGL format.

methods.name: ValidDesktopType
methods.description: Checks if a given GLenum type is a valid desktop OpenGL type.

methods.name: ValidDesktopFormatCombination
methods.description: Determines if a combination of format, type, and internalFormat is valid according to OpenGL 4.6 specifications.
